events.title: US-Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The US-Iran conflict is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and the stock market. Geopolitical tensions are rising, and investors are becoming increasingly cautious.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict escalation could lead to increased oil prices, which would negatively impact oil-dependent stocks. However, the broader market may also be affected, making it a good time to buy into the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. On the other hand, shorting the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF could be a good strategy if oil prices drop due to decreased demand.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices stabilize or if the conflict de-escalates
otherFactors: Monitor US interest rates and inflation
